title: situation.lamon_promise.title
railroad: Governor Pickens's telegram of 30 March, asking whether Colonel Lamon spoke for the government; Lamon's visit to Charleston is not modelled, so the question comes on its date

gate.none: a back-channel assurance about the fort; no gate topic

citations.at: I-1 p. 282 (Beauregard to Walker, 26 March: Lamon "saying that Major Anderson and command would soon be withdrawn")
I-53 pp. 162 to 163 (Campbell, 13 April: Pickens's telegram of 30 March and Seward's note of 1 April)
